description: Save the canonical threat model, findings and coverage as an unsealed draft. Use complete:false as soon as a model is available, even with empty findings and partial coverage, then for progress checkpoints; use complete:true for the final result. The host derives threatmodel.md. Keep unvalidated candidates in coverage.deferred. On terminal Standard or diff drafts, close generic review tasks with coverage.resolvedDeferred:[{id,reason}], copying IDs from the returned coverage. Update linked surfaces by their saved IDs.

complete.description: Set false to save progress without declaring this worker or parent audit finished. Omit or set true only for the terminal result. Put provisional candidates in coverage.deferred, not findings.

completeness.description: Use partial if any work is deferred or any surface needs follow-up; use complete only when no such work remains.

deferred.description: Each supplied id identifies one task and must be unique within this draft. Reuse saved IDs in later updates.

resolvedDeferred.description: On final Standard or diff drafts, close generic tasks by saved ID and completion reason. Reuse saved surface IDs for updates. Candidate tasks need findings or dispositions; redundant closure entries for those outcomes are ignored.

disposition.description: The evidence-supported review result for this surface.

label.description: The meaningful name of the reviewed security surface.

code.description: The genuine, nonempty source snippet at this evidence location.

source.description: The actual finding producer. Use local_plugin only for a finding discovered by this plugin.

sourceFindingIds.description: Host-provided source finding references represented by this Deep reduction. Preserve every assigned reference exactly once.

sourceFindings.description: Original source payloads retained by the host for lossless semantic merges.

ruleId.description: A stable lowercase vulnerability-family slug, such as prototype-pollution.json-patch; a CWE is taxonomy, not a rule ID.

category.description: The actual primary broken security control, not a CWE identifier.

cwe.description: Copy the reviewed candidate's exact cwe_ids array. Use an empty array when no CWE is established; do not invent one.

scope.description: The modeled source scope, which may differ from the scan scope. Omit when unknown.

threatModel.description: Retained threat-model content. Existing structured models remain supported; Markdown documents preserve their complete original body.
